description: A source-aligned follow-up to Increment 53. The remaining historical alignment cases, and all voiced say-events in Chapters 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9, were checked against the gp32 English event text and the active Persian source. style_guide: Narration uses contemporary literary-conversational Persian: intimate, restrained, natural, and never uniformly formal or slang-heavy.
Dialogue remains spoken and character-specific; preserve hesitation, pauses, and unfinished phrases.
Preserve source meaning and emotional understatement; do not add explanations or actions not present in the English.
Correct translationese, semantic drift, awkward collocations, and lost nuances without over-editing faithful existing Persian.

review_scope.method: The 48 remaining historical alignment entries were re-examined against the English gp32 source and active Persian recovery text; eight clear revisions were proposed. In addition, all 63 Chapter 9, 167 Chapter 8, 186 Chapter 7, 160 Chapter 5, and 221 Chapter 6 say-events not present in Increments 38, 52, or 53 were checked against the English source. Fifteen Chapter 9, 45 Chapter 8, 34 Chapter 7, 28 Chapter 5, and 37 Chapter 6 targeted revisions were proposed, while faithful lines and ambiguous event boundaries were retained. Together with existing proofread coverage, this completes the first source-aligned assistant review of all 117 Chapter 9, 261 Chapter 8, 252 Chapter 7, 238 Chapter 5, and 290 Chapter 6 say-events.
